_comment_readme: This is a documentation snippet, not a full settings.json. `<CLAUDE_HOME>` means wherever you installed the harness and this adapter's agent/skill/script files, typically `%USERPROFILE%\.claude` on Windows. `<path-to-your-vault>` is your Obsidian (or plain Markdown) memory vault. `<your-memory-scope>` is the relative folder inside that vault where this harness's notes live, e.g. `02 Projects\Claude Code Memory`. Merge the `env` and `hooks` keys below into your existing `<CLAUDE_HOME>\settings.json` -- do not overwrite the whole file, and remove this `_comment_readme` key before merging since real settings.json does not support comments. This single hook is optional: the adapter works with zero hooks if you only want the memory-curator skill/subagent and manual recall/handoff scripts.
